build_load_dataset: build a function to load and vectorize the 20 newsgroups dataset with TF-IDF features
run_benchmark: run a benchmark to measure training time, test time, and accuracy of a text classifier
create_plot_feature_effects: create a plot showing average feature effects and top predictive words per class
create_size_mb: create a utility to compute the size in megabytes of a list of text documents
test_classifiers: test multiple classifiers including logistic regression, ridge, kNN, and naive Bayes on text data
